Results and contract terms

GEO promotion with contractual financial guarantees

BMR targets at months 1, 2 and 3: +5, +10 and +15 percentage points from baseline. Pay 50% fixed and 50% on reaching the corresponding monthly target.

from RUB 114,900/month

Monthly service

  • From 50 prompts and 5 AI platforms
  • I implement and improve the website, and create content
  • BMR targets: baseline +5 / +10 / +15 pp
  • 50% fixed + 50% bonus at the target BMR
  • Comparable measurements and monthly reporting
Discuss the terms

BMR targets for the first 3 months

First, we record the initial BMR: the share of measured AI answers mentioning your brand. Each target below is measured relative to that initial result.

  1. Month 1Baseline + 5 pp
  2. Month 2Baseline + 10 pp
  3. Month 3Baseline + 15 pp

Example: a 20% baseline means targets of 25%, 30% and 35%. We retain an agreed prompt set, platform set and counting method so the measurements remain comparable. The payment model is 50% fixed and a 50% bonus upon reaching the target for the relevant month.

What the financial guarantee means

This format ties part of the payment to a measured promotion result. We first record the baseline BMR. Targets for the next 3 months are +5 percentage points at the end of month 1, +10 at the end of month 2 and +15 at the end of month 3. Each increase is calculated from the baseline.

BMR, or Brand Mention Rate, is the share of received answers that name the brand. A 20% baseline therefore gives monthly targets of 25%, 30% and 35%. Payment for each month consists of a 50% fixed portion and a 50% performance fee on reaching that month’s target. The target schedule and measurement method are recorded in the contract.

BMR formula and measurement rules →

The work covered by this format

The scope includes intent mapping, at least 50 prompts and 5 AI platforms, website changes, content creation, distribution, link promotion and reputation work. Reporting takes place once a month. Tasks are agreed in relation to the business’s starting position and the project objective.

Under the guarantee plan, I personally implement all agreed website improvements, create content and arrange publication. Half of the monthly fee is linked to the BMR target. Website work covers service information, page structure, links between materials and technical requirements. A new website remains a separate development project.

Compare with GEO + content →Separate website development service →

Agreeing how results are verified

Before the engagement, we record the exact prompts, AI platforms, language and market. The baseline and later measurements use a comparable fixed set. The protocol defines a brand mention and the treatment of missing answers. Source responses are retained to verify each monthly target.

When coverage expands, the original matrix is retained separately. Adding successful prompts or platforms can change the overall percentage, so progress is compared on the same sample. Alongside BMR, we examine the nature of recommendations and accuracy of information; enquiries and sales are assessed using business data.

Starting a contract discussion

Share your website, priority services, market and the role you want AI recommendations to play in attracting customers. We discuss existing material, the ability to change the site and who can verify business facts. This helps relate the objective to the actual work required.

A free mini-audit is available as an introduction, while the full audit provides a detailed assessment. The baseline measurement determines the 3 contractual BMR targets: +5 / +10 / +15 percentage points. With a high baseline, the applicability of this schedule is checked before signing. Initial changes may appear from 1 week; the performance fee is assessed against the corresponding monthly target.

FAQ

Questions about this service

How is payment structured?+
Each month has a 50% fixed payment and a 50% performance fee on reaching its BMR target. Targets for months 1, 2 and 3 are baseline BMR +5, +10 and +15 percentage points respectively. Measurement and payment terms are recorded in the contract.
What BMR growth is specified over 3 months?+
The target at the end of month 1 is baseline BMR +5 percentage points, then +10 at month 2 and +15 at month 3. A 20% baseline gives targets of 25%, 30% and 35%. These are percentage-point increases, not relative percentage growth.
Does this guarantee sales or a place in every answer?+
The contractual target concerns BMR across the agreed matrix. Sales and enquiry quality are measured separately; AI responses are assessed using the agreed methodology.
Are website work and content included?+
I implement and refine the agreed website improvements myself, create content and organize publication. Building a new website is a separate service.
What happens if the baseline BMR is already high?+
The applicability of the targets is checked before signing. If adding 15 percentage points would exceed 100%, the terms require separate agreement; the target is not automatically capped at 100%.
